heading: Manish
route: 14 Nov: Delhi - 15 Nov: Delhi - 16 Nov: Delhi - Haridwar - 17 Nov: Haridwar - Rishikesh - Haridwar - 18 Nov: Haridwar - Mathura - 19 Nov: Mathura - Agra - 20 Nov: Agra - Fatehpur Sikri - Jaipur - 21 Nov: Jaipur - 22 Nov: Jaipur - Chennai - 23 Nov: Chennai - Mahabalipuram - Kanchipuram - Tirupati - 24 Nov: Tirupati - Delhi - 25 Nov: Delhi
summary:
India Golden Triangle and Religious Tour for Ms. Vidya and Group Delhi- Haridwar- Mathura – Vrindavan – Agra - Jaipur – Chennai- Mahabalipuram- Kanchipuram - Tirupati- Delhi- Home Town. (11 Nights - 12 Days)

th

paras.text: Welcome at Indira Gandhi International Airport on arrival at 7.30 pm at Delhi with a PLA card of your name and transferred by a/c mini coach to the pre-booked hotel. After check in, our representative will hand over all required documents related to the tour and service and brief you about the tour - intercity travel, sightseeing places, stopovers, eating places, local SIM card, money exchange, tips etc., rest of the time for relaxation. Dinner and overnight at the hotel.
Services: Hotel accommodation with dinner and transportation for transfer.
Delhi, the towering capital city of the independent and largest democratic country in the world: India.

Delhi is located and sprawled on both banks of Yamuna River. The city is enriched with culture, architecture and human diversity, Delhi city is a blend of the ancient past of India with the vibration of the modern world. The city designed by the British architect Sir Edwin Lutyens (1869-1944) & is tree- lined & spacious. Legend has it that the Pandavas of epic Mahabharata, the august heroes, founded Delhi around 1200 BC & the name of the city was Indraprastha.
th

After breakfast take a sightseeing tour of Old Delhi : visiting at Rajghat, the memorial of Mahatma Gandhi, where he was cremated. The sightseeing continues to explore New Delhi: Visiting India Gate; built to honour and pay a tribute to the Indian soldiers who sacrificed themselves during the Afghan war, Birla Mandir (Laxmi Narayan Temple), Lotus shaped Bhai’s Temple, Qutub Minar; built by Qutub-ud- din Aibek of the Slave Dynasty. Later visit to Chattarpur Temple:

dedicated to the goddess Katyayani. The entire complex of the temple is spread over a wide area of 28 hectares. In the evening - visit most famous Swaminarayan Akshardham Temple, 'Akshardham' means the divine abode of God. Showcasing 10000 years of Indian culture in all its breath-taking grandeur, beauty, wisdom and bliss. If time permits optionally, you can attend the Light and Sound show in the temple complex. After visit return to the hotel for dinner and overnight stay.
Services: Hotel accommodation with breakfast and dinner, transportation for sightseeing with guide.

The Akshardham temple , which attracts approximately 70 % of all tourists who visit Delhi, it is the largest Hindu temple after the Akshardham in Gandhinagar both inspired and developed by Pramukh Swami Maharaj, the spiritual head of the Bochasanwasi Shri Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Sanstha, whose 3,000 volunteers helped 7,000 artisans construct the temple. Musical fountain Known as the Yagnapurush Kund, it is India's largest step well.
th

After breakfast check out the hotel and drive to Haridwar, on arrival transfer to the hotel. After relaxation, in the evening attend the most speculative “Ganga Aarti” at the holy River Ganga. Aarti takes place on the ghat in the evening after sunset. A group of Brahmans hold huge fire bowls in their hands and offer their holy mantras to river Ganges, Shiva - the Hindu God of destruction, Surya - the Sun God and the entire Universe. The scenario at Har - Ki - Pauri at the time of Ganga-Aarti is mesmerizing. Afterwards return to the hotel for dinner and overnight stay.
Services: Breakfast at Delhi hotel and Haridwar hotel with dinner, transportation for Ganga Aarti: Guide is not required.

Haridwar: ‘The gateway to the Gods'. "This place is very beautiful", at one site one will say so and fall in love with the scenic beauty of the blend of height and plains. In its long history back to pre-historic time, the Haridwar got its name from the rishis. According to the mythology it is known as Kapilsthan, legend goes that the Suryavnshi Prince Bhagirath performed penance here to salvage the souls of his ancestors who had perished due to the curse of the sage Kapila. The penance was answered and the river Ganga trickled forth from Lord Shiva's locks and its bountiful waters revived the sixty thousand sons of King Sagara. Mythologically, drops of nectar churned out from the primordial ocean fell at the four sites of the Kumbh mela including Haridwar.
th

Today early morning you may opt to take holy dip in Ganga, thereafter return to the hotel for breakfast. Later take a religious and spiritual sightseeing tour of Haridwar and Rishikesh. Visiting Mansa Devi Temple and if time permits visit to Chandidevi Temple: one of the most popular and most visited temples of Haridwar, thereafter

take an excursion to Rishikesh- on the way stop over at Bharat Mata Temple and Laxman Jhoola, on arrival visit Parmath Niketan and Triveni Ghat, if time permits - Gita Bhawan Ashram, afterward drive back to Haridwar for dinner and overnight stay.
Services: Hotel accommodation with breakfast and dinner, transportation for sightseeing with guide .

Rishikesh , also known as the 'place of sages' is Haridwar, at the confluence of the Chandrabhaga and Ganga. It is believed that God by the name of 'Hrishikesh' had appeared as and answers to the hard penances by Rabhiya Rishi and henceforth the place derived its name. It is most ideal destinations for meditation, yoga and other aspects of Hinduism. For the adventure seekers, Rishikesh is the suggested place for starting their trekking expeditions to the Himalayan peaks and for rafting. Also, International Yoga Week, which attracts participation from across the world, is held here, every year, in February on the banks of the Ganga.
th

Today morning after early breakfast, check out the hotel and drive to Mathura on arrival check into the hotel. After relaxation, in the evening visit the most prominent temple of Mathura: Krishna Janam Bhoomi (Janamshtan – Birth Place) Temple: It is built around the prison cell in which Lord Krishna’s parents; mother Devaki and father Vasudeva were imprisoned by his evil uncle Kansa. If time permits you can visit to Kansa Fort (Kans Qila). Later visit to ISKCON temple for darshan and kirtan. Afterwards return to the hotel for dinner and overnight stay.
Services: Breakfast at Haridwar Hotel, Mathura Hotel with dinner, transportation for sightseeing with guide in Mathura.

Mathura and Vrindavan , twin cities in Uttar Pradesh, India, are revered as the land of Lord Krishna's birth and childhood, making them a major pilgrimage destination for Hindus. Mathura is known as Krishna's birthplace, while Vrindavan is where he spent his childhood, playing with friends and engaging in divine pastimes. A trip to Mathura-Vrindavan offers a blend of spiritual experiences, historical sites, and cultural immersion. The notable and most popular sightseeing places and temples are Krishna Janam Bhoomi Temple, Prem Mandir, Banke Bihar Temple, ISKCON Temple, Nidhivan.
th

Today early morning, check out the hotel and drive to Vrindavan (15 kms from Mathura) to attend the morning Aarti at Banke Bihari Temple and other nearby temples of your choice. The visit will be arranged for later visit Nand Bhawan and Gokul Charan Mandir located in Gokul. In the evening visit to Nidhivan: the land of Krishna’s playful dance, Prem Mandir (Kirtan 7.00 pm-7.30 pm). Afterwards continue to drive to Agra, on arrival transfer to the hotel. In the evening visit Oswal Emporium to watch the replica of Taj Mahal it took 10 years for the artists to build this artistic epitome, also enjoy Light and
Sound show “Mohabbat-the-Taj: The Saga of Love”, the only show of its kind in India! Later return to the hotel for dinner and overnight stay.
Services: Breakfast at Mathura Hotel, Agra Hotel with dinner, transportation for sightseeing with guide at Vrindavan, no guide for Light and Sound Show in Agra.
th

Today early in the morning visit world’s most popular and beautiful monument: Taj Mahal with its’ fabulous view at the time of sunrise. Taj Mahal, a beautiful architectural monument is one of the 7 wonders of the world. Afterwards return to the hotel for breakfast, later tour continues with a visit to Agra Fort . The built by Mughal Emperor Akbar, here you will find the splendid Pearl Mosque and various other classic example of architecture. Afterwards drive to Jaipur, if time permits - enroute stop over at Fatehpur Sikri, the old deserted town of the Mughal kingdom; it is an example of robust stability combined with originality and known for one of the largest and tallest gateways in the world . Later continue drive to Jaipur. On arrival, transfer to the hotel. After relaxation, enjoy evening at most popular Enjoy the evening at the most authentic and ethnic village resort: called Chokhi Dhani (around 15kms from the city centre) designed on the theme of an ethnic village of Rajasthan with lots of traditional environment with entertainment like folk dances, puppet shows, astrology, music, camel ride, here you can enjoy the traditional Rajasthani food. Afterwards return back to hotel for overnight stay.

Services: Breakfast at Agra Hotel, Jaipur hotel without dinner: Dinner at Chokhi Dhani. transportation for sightseeing with guide at Agra & Fatehpur Sikri. Guide is not required during visit at Chokhi Dhani.

Jaipur is widely known as the ‘Pink City’ of India. The walls, houses and buildings of the entire city were washed with pink colour for a grand and royal welcome of Prince Albert and Queen Victoria of Britain, who visited Jaipur in 1853 A.D. This splendid city as was founded in 1727 A.D by one of the greatest ruler Jai Singh II. Jaipur is surrounded by hills on three sides. Jaipur is the only city in the world, which is designed in accordance with Hindu architectural science called Shilpa Shastra. The city had been designed in rectangular shape of 9 blocks, depicting the 9 partitions of the universe. This fascinating city houses - majestic forts, grand palaces, lavish gardens, havelis and museums. While visiting these places you will have a true vision of the royal golden past of Rajasthan.
st
Today morning after breakfast explore the Pink City with an excursion to
th

splendid Amber Fort, situated just outside the city, built in the 15 Century by Rajput King Man Singh. Later visit another mighty and majestic Nahargarh Fort, visiting nearby place - Jagat Shiromani Temple . Afterwards drive back to city to visit the imperial City Palace - present residence of the royal family of Jaipur, the palace is a miraculous representation of the real Rajasthani and Mughal architecture. Then visit the incredible Jantar Mantar was innovated and constructed by Jaipur King Swai

Jai Singh, splendid Hawa Mahal: (from outside) also known ‘Palace of Winds’ thereafter visit to Galta Ji (Monkey Temple) known for a holy pond, followed by: Birla Temple, with its white shimmering marble glittering in the night, also nearby temple of Ganesha: Moti Dungri Temple. In the evening you may opt to go for shopping as Jaipur, the city is known as Paradise of Shopping for Handicraft, Jewellery, Precious stones, Carpets, Clothes etc., Later return to the hotel for dinner and overnight stay.
Services: Hotel accommodation with breakfast and dinner, transportation for sightseeing with guide.
nd

Today early morning, check out the hotel and transfer to the Jaipur Airport to board Indigo flight 6E5362 for Chennai, departing at 9.55 hrs , assistance on arrival at Chennai Airport at 12.35 hrs and transfer to the hotel. After relaxation visit to Fort St. George, the seat of the state government and the legislative assembly, nearby St. Mary`s church, later visit at Kapaleeshwarar Temple, a pure Dravidian temple and one of the most ancient in Chennai. Another important temple in the city is Parthasarathy Temple ; dedicated to Lord Krishna, Government Museum with its galleries off chola Bronzes. In the evening visit to most popular Marina Beach, second longest beach of the world. Later visit to Iskon Temple: Chennai to attend evening Aarti between 8 pm to 9 pm. If time permits you can visit local market for shopping, then return to the hotel for dinner and overnight stay at Chennai.
Services: Jaipur hotel breakfast if time permits, Chennai Hotel with dinner, transportation for sightseeing with guide in Chennai.

Chennai (Madras): the capital of the state of Tamil Nadu is the most convenient point of entry for the state. Chennai has an international airport, a seaport, a rail and road network that links it to all major towns and cities of the region. Tamil Nadu is a bastion of Hinduism, whose past endures into the present. Temples with towering spires called gopurams are a common feature of this state, seldom seen anywhere else in the country. Temples in Tamil Nadu were the fulcrums of society and even today art forms that find their origin in religious worship continue to colour daily life. Notable among these are splendid bronzes of deities, glass paintings and Bharatnatyam - an evocative dance form.
rd

Today morning, after breakfast check out the Chennai hotel and drive to Mahabalipuram (60 kms: 1 ½ hr) the ancient city is situated on the shore of Bay of Bengal, famous for Its stone carvings, this UNESCO World Heritage Site Has Many Rock-cut Monuments Dating from 7th – 9th Century, here you can visit to Shore Temples and Seashore Beach, Pancha Rathas, Arjuna's Penance, Mahishasurmardini Cave and panoramic view of Light house. Afterwards proceed to Kanchipuram (50 kms: 1 ½ hr) to explore the ancient capital of the Pallavas famous, here visit the most famous temple of Lord Shiva: Kailasanathar; built during 685 A.D. to 705 A.D. Later you must visit at the world-famous SILK CLOTH MARKET for shopping of silk sarees, clothes and other handicraft product. Afterwards continue to proceed to
Tirupati (120 kms: 2-3 hrs from Kanchipuram), on arrival transfer to the hotel for dinner and overnight at Tirupati.
Services: Breakfast at Chennai hotel, Transportation and guide services at Mahabalipuram and Kanchipuram.
Tirupati hotel with dinner. Transportation for Tirupati, no guide is required in Tirupati.

Mahabalipuram with its picturesque location on a rocky outcrop between the beach and a lagoon is a happy combination of history, good beaches, hassle-free tourism, fabulous fish and lobster! Despite the many visitors, drawn by the former Pallava dynasty town, the place is friendly, relaxed, and the villagers are remarkably unperturbed by their crowds of visitors. Mahabalipuram is renowned for its series of charming rathas and the spectacular carved relic depicting Arjuna's Penance. The magnificent Shore Temple, built by King Rajasimha in the seventh century, is a unique temple that houses the shrines of both Shiva and Vishnu while the Varaha Cave is one of the many rock-cut caves in Mahabalipuram. The Krishna Mandapam has a relic of Lord Krishna lifting the Govardhan hill in his fingertips.

Kanchipuram is known as one of India's Seven Sacred cities and the historical capital of the Pallavas. It was under the Pallavas from 6th to 8th century A.D and later became the citadel of Cholas, Vijayanagar Kings, the Muslim and the British. It has been a centre of Tamil learning, cultural and religious background for centuries. Kanchi is also known as the centre of the finest silk sarees made in the country. Kanchi has magnificent temples of unique architectural beauty bearing eloquent testimony to its glorious Dravidian heritage. Adi Sankara established his Episcopal seat (Kamakotipeetam) here in the city. The city is also the birthplace of C.N. Annadurai, former Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu affectionately called as "Anna" by the people of Tamil Nadu.
th

Today early morning visit for morning prayers of Lord Balaji - The crown jewel of Tirumala, this opulent temple is dedicated to Lord Vishnu. Witness the ornate architecture, intricate carvings, and experience the awe-inspiring darshan (holy visit) of the revered Tirupati Balaji, if time permits visit at Padmavati Lakshmi Mandir and Sri Anjaneyaswami Temple. Later return to the hotel, after relaxation check out the hotel and transfer to Tirupati Airport to board the Air India Flight AI 2890 departing for Delhi at 1510 hrs, oscitance on arrival at Delhi at 1955 hrs. Check into the hotel. Dinner and overnight at the hotel in Delhi.
Services: Breakfast at Tirupati hotel, Tirupati Temple visit of your own, guides are now allowed, transportation for airport transfer at Tirupati and Delhi.

The Tirumala Hills are part of Seshachalam Hills range. The hills are 853m above sea level. The Hills comprises seven peaks, representing the seven heads of Adisesha. The temple lies on the seventh peak - Venkatadri, on the southern banks of Sri Swami Pushkarini, a holy water tank. Hence the temple is also referred to as "Temple of Seven Hills". Tirupati’s presiding deity; Lord Venkateswara, is famous all over the world as the giver of boons, and is paid homage by people across all religions and races. The Temple is dedicated to Lord Venkateswara, an incarnation of Vishnu, who is believed to have appeared here to
save mankind from trials and troubles of Kali Yuga.
th

Today morning after breakfast and day is free for relaxation till the early noon. If time permits you can visit to nearby market for shopping. Later check out the hotel and transfer to the Indira Gandhi International Airport around 1.00 pm to board the scheduled flight at 4.10 pm for home town on departure the tour ends with happy memories with our good wishes for safe journey.
Services: Breakfast at Delhi hotel and transportation for short visit to city and airport transfer. No guide is required.
